Strong liquidity (current ratio 1.92), very high capitalization quality (equity of 29,833M versus liabilities of 21,966M, with equity/assets near 58%), and robust profitability (EBIT of 2,489M on 5,638M revenue) support a high-grade profile. While the balance sheet is notably conservative, the available data are not sufficient to justify the very top tier, so a low-AA assessment is most fitting.

DECISION: AA-
